import sys

def ok(w, m):
    if m <= 0:
        return True
    d = m % w
    next_val = m // w
    if d > w / 2:
        d = w - d
        next_val += 1
    if d > 1:
        return False
    return ok(w, next_val)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    w = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    print("YES" if ok(w, m) else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
